Title: Koyarwar Svelte — Lily Design System

# Koyarwar Svelte

Ɗakin karatun Svelte na Lily shi ne aiwatarwa ta asali: runes na Svelte 5, props masu rubutu, yaɗa sauran props, da ɗaurin hanyoyi biyu da `bind:value`.

## Abin da za ka gina

Ƙaramin fom na tuntuɓa — fili mai lakabi, maɓallin aikawa, ɗaurin hanyoyi biyu, ainihin halayyar maɓallan rubutu da na'urar karanta allo — da farko ba tare da tsari ba, sannan da tsari, cikin kusan mintuna 10.

## Kafin ka fara

Kana buƙatar git, Node 22 ko sabo, da pnpm 10 ko sabo. Kowane aikin Svelte 5 yana aiki — sabon `npx sv create` app ya isa.

## Mataki na 1 — Ɗauki lambar

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-svelte-headless
pnpm install
pnpm test        # vitest — thousands of component cases
pnpm run storybook   # browse all 608 components
```

Abubuwan suna cikin `src/lib/components/&#123;Name&#125;/`, kundin adireshi ɗaya ga kowane abu mai fayil ɗin `.svelte` , gwaje-gwajensa, story da takardunsa tare. Kwafi kundin adireshin da kake buƙata zuwa app ɗinka, ko dogara da ma'ajiyar ka shigo kai tsaye.

## Mataki na 2 — Abu na farko naka

```
<script>
  import Button from "#lib/components/Button/Button.svelte";

  function save() { console.log("saved"); }
</script>

<Button onclick={save}>Save</Button>
```

Yana nuna `<button class="button" type="button">`. Props suna da rubutu: `type`, `disabled`, `pressed` (yana nuna `aria-pressed` (yana nuna `label` ( `aria-label` ga maɓallan sauyawa),

## Mataki na 3 — Haɗa ƙaramin fom

```
<script>
  import Form from "#lib/components/Form/Form.svelte";
  import Field from "#lib/components/Field/Field.svelte";
  import TextInput from "#lib/components/TextInput/TextInput.svelte";
  import Button from "#lib/components/Button/Button.svelte";

  let name = $state("");
</script>

<Form label="Contact form" onsubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <Field label="Full name" required>
    <TextInput id="name" label="Full name" bind:value={name} required />
  </Field>
  <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
</Form>
```

`Field` yana ɗaukar `label` a matsayin prop nasa maimakon abin lakabi da aka saka a ciki — ka ba shi sau ɗaya, a kan `Field`da `TextInput`mai dacewa na `label` yana ba da suna mai sauƙin isa. `TextInput`'s `value` don gyara), kuma kowace ƙarin sifa tana yaɗuwa a kan tushe. `$bindable` prop ne na `bind:value` rune, don haka

**An tabbatar a 2026-08-29:** yana ba ka ɗaurin hanyoyi biyu nan take. `svelte/server` an haɗa ainihin wannan gutsuren ta `<label for>` kuma an duba shi don lakabi ɗaya tilo, da aka haɗa daidai `Label` a cikin `Field`— wani daftarin da ya gabata ya saka *lakabi* biyu (ɗaya fanko) saboda `Field` tuni yana nuna nasa daga shigarwar `label` daban a ciki, wanda ya nuna [Hanyar fom ɗin tuntuɓa da aka haɗa](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/lily-design-system-svelte-sveltekit-examples/src/routes/contact-form/%2Bpage.svelte) tsari ɗaya ne, wanda aka gwada da ainihin gwaje-gwajen e2e da axe.

**Duba aikinka:** gudanar da app ɗin kuma fom ɗin yana kama da maras tsari — daidai kamar yadda aka nufa: tsarin yana nan gaba. Danna `Tab`: mayar da hankali yana ratsa kowane abin sarrafawa, ana sanar da lakabin, kuma aikawa yana aiki. An gama halayyar; kamannin naka ne kuma shi ne mataki na gaba.

## Mataki na 4 — Ba shi tsari

Komai da ke sama ana zana shi a matsayin tsari tsantsa, a shirye don salonka. Ba ƙugiyoyin aji tsari — `.button`, `.text-input`, `.label`, `.field` — a takardar salonka ta duniya, ko haɗa jigon da aka shirya a cikin `app.html`:

```
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/dark.css" />
```

Gyare-gyare ga kowane misali suna ratsa `class` prop, wanda ake ƙara shi zuwa ƙugiyar tushe: `<Button class="wide">` yana nuna `class="button wide"`.

## Mataki na 5 — Kalli komai yana aiki

[App ɗin misali na SvelteKit](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/examples/) shi ne kundin guda ɗaya da cikakken tsari, tare da nunin kai tsaye, gwaje-gwajen Playwright e2e da tushen sauƙin isa na axe-core:

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-svelte-sveltekit-examples
pnpm install && pnpm run dev
```

## Matakai na gaba

- [Jigogi](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/tutorials/theming/) — sauyawa lokacin aiki da mai taimakon theme-picker na Svelte.
- [Masu taimakon abubuwan so](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/tutorials/helpers/) — harshe da girman rubutu.
- [Kundin abubuwa](https://lilydesignsystem.com/components/) — siffofi, ARIA da maɓallan rubutu ga kowane abu.

Tambayoyi a hanya? [Shafin taimako](https://lilydesignsystem.com/help/#troubleshooting) cike yake da amsoshi — kuma idan wani mataki zai iya zama mafi bayyana, [gaya mana](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem) kuma za mu gyara koyarwar da farin ciki.
